ValidationRule.description: Users other than Admin Profile cannot change Account Name
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(DW_Account_Type__c, "Global Customer"), ISPICKVAL(DW_Account_Type__c, "Business Name")) && ISCHANGED(Name),(NOW() - CreatedDate>0.000117),
OR(
AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "Operations Admin")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To change an Account Name, contact your Salesforce Administrator.
